summary.name: Thermal Silhouette Imaging (Drawing and Illustration; source twoclipping-041659, added 2026-10-12).
summary.visualIdentity: Sharp silhouettes, authored as a head profile in the source, filled with an illustrative heat ramp from black through red and orange to cream. The core runs warmer than the edges, narrow extremities such as the nose and ears cool, and authored hotspots add cream glow. This is illustrative heat, not measured temperature data.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly suited to thermal-illustration videos or interactive HTML where a stylized heat metaphor serves the brief. Inferred: concept explainers about body warmth or heat that are clearly labeled illustrative. Unsuitable for heat-scale legends, degree readouts, or claims of measured data.
summary.limitations: No temperature scale, degrees, or legend may be shown. Thermal scenes keep an opaque black background, and paper or red scenes are separate clips. The yellow poster is an opening card, not the thermal background. Background evidence rests on one reference poster, so full-video scene verification is not claimed.
summary.palette: Tokens: background #080808 (opaque scene field only), foreground #FFF1D5 (layout text), accent_1 #C82E20, accent_2 #F07C30. The heat gradient, enabled only inside the silhouette mask, runs black, red, orange, cream via chroma-js in LAB. Foreground-on-background contrast is 17.924. Hex values are authored approximations; task-supplied colors override them. Never substitute an accent or material for the background, and do not add hues.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: the 3-second preview warms the silhouette from black through red to cream hotspots. A slow seeded value-noise shimmer is driven by composition time. GSAP tweens hotspot intensities, warm-up progress, and time on a paused, seekable timeline. Deliberate sharp cuts between clips are authored. No motion references are selected, and interaction behavior is unspecified.
summary.audio: Unspecified in the source; no audio direction is provided. Inferred suggestion: restrained ambience or low-energy background music could support the slow warm-up and shimmer, with voiceover optional. Any audio must be authorized, keep speech intelligible, avoid clipping, and be verified against picture sync in the final video.
summary.assetRequirements: Requires an authored head-profile silhouette, rasterized once with Canvas 2D into a mask texture, plus a blurred distance-like copy for interior falloff. Also needs authored hotspot data (position, radius, intensity) and a fixed noise seed. Local fonts and assets must load before rendering. Source poster is reference-only, and no other assets are specified.
summary.combinations: Keep this style dominant. The suggested secondary style is style-093, used only for readable caption timing, and its palette must not be imported. Preserve the primary background and foreground roles, and avoid competing full-scene treatments or subject-material backgrounds. For HTML, make motion optional under reduced-motion preferences.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: Three.js WebGLRenderer with an orthographic fullscreen quad and a GLSL ShaderMaterial, with Canvas 2D for the mask. Motion engine: GSAP on a paused timeline driving uniforms. Pipeline: HyperFrames by default for check, snapshot, and render, with Remotion only on a verified fallback. Verify no double gamma correction. Task inputs such as subject, duration, aspect ratio, resolution, frame rate, and output directory are unspecified.
